item.tib: gsang mchog gsang ba 'dus pa gsang ba'i bdag/ 'chi med tshe dbang rig 'dzin thugs bcud bka'/ bder gshegs stong dang rtsa bzhi'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ mdo chog u dum wa ra'i phreng ba
item.coloph: de nas 'od kor dgon du rang mal slebs nas bstan pa'i dbu bzung dus rig ldan ma'i dri med dar dang tshogs kyi mchod pa bcas rmi nyams rtags bzang shar ba lo rgyus kyis mtshams sbyar te brda yi sgo 'byed pa'i rten 'brel lde mig sna drangs/ lhag par 'dra mig dgon gyi mkhan po g.yung drung rgyal mtshan dang rtogs ldan g.yung drung dbang rgyal sogs bla grwa mang po'i (pos) bskul ba dang*/ rang slob las kyi 'brel ba'i grogs bstan pa rgyal mtshan nas bris gzhi bcas bskul ba dang / 'od kor dgon gyi bla grwa thams cad dang cha yul dbon po tshe dbang rig 'dzin sogs rang slob bla grwa kun nas phab dgos bskul bzhin/ (?)'gyur med pas 'od kor dgon du rtogs ldan sangs rgyas kyi gzim khang 'od gsal 'bar ba'i sgrub khang du dgongs pa rig pa'i brda la brtags pa shar ba phab grub pas/ mdo zab mo 'di yi sems can gang+ga'i klung gi bye ma'i grangs ldan 'dren pa'i rgyu ru shog cig gi smon lam mtshams sbyar ro/
